decisions.reason: It fits our move toward connected and data-driven infrastructure management and is likely the stronger of the archiving offerings, though there remains some risk of software portfolio simplification.
Because it overlaps with Product A, had weaker website prominence, and we are pushing toward a clearer web-based software platform, we would discontinue this one and concentrate resources elsewhere.
